subject: Welcome to Encord!
text:
Hi [NAME],

Happy new year - I hope the holidays went well :)

Wanted to reach out to officially welcome you & the Withings team to
Encord! We are delighted that you've chosen us as your partner & we are
really excited to get going.

I have cc'd @[SENDER] <[EMAIL]> who will be your Customer
Success Manager here at Encord.

I have made sure [SENDER] is up to speed with our previous conversations, so
we can pick up right where we left off.

I know you are planning studies now, when does it make sense to schedule an
onboarding session ahead of the first study? I have shared a placeholder
for some time in February. Do let me know if you'd like to move it forward.

I'm looking forward to continuing to support Withings with your goals &
objectives. Please feel free to reach out if you have any questions or need
further assistance.

text:

I saw that a few senior automation / robotics execs (Kris, Devin, [SENDER], etc.) including yourself have moved over from Amazon to [COMPANY] in the last year - looks like the team is growing into new use cases (ex: cleaning robots with the OhmniLabs acquisition) on top of the traditional ones like palletization and box-picking.

Hope all's well and that you had a cozy holiday season,
